---
title: "Refund an Order"
description: "Return money to the customer for an order."
---

You refund a customer from the order's detail page. A refund returns part or all of a captured payment for the order.

<Steps>
  <Step title="Open the orders list">
    Go to **Orders** in the sidebar. The page lists the orders that include your products. Select the order you want to work on.
    <Frame>
      <img src="/images/user-guide/vendor/refund-an-order/step-1.png" alt="Open the orders list" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Open the order">
    Selecting a row opens the order's detail page, where you manage fulfillment, shipping, payments, and returns for your part of the order.
  </Step>
  <Step title="Review the order">
    The detail page shows the order's items, customer, payments, and fulfillment status. Work from here.
    <Frame>
      <img src="/images/user-guide/vendor/refund-an-order/step-3.png" alt="Review the order" />
    </Frame>
  </Step>
  <Step title="Create the refund">
    In the **Payments** section, open the actions menu and choose **Refund**. Enter the amount to refund and a reason, then confirm. The refund is issued against the order's captured payment.
  </Step>
</Steps>
